name: What should homeowners prepare before planning a whole-house renovation?

mainEntity.name: What should homeowners prepare before planning a whole-house renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before starting, gather property documents, note structural problem areas, compile functional priorities, and establish a realistic budget contingency. Clarify which aspects are critical—such as opening up a cramped kitchen or reconfiguring a primary suite—versus secondary aesthetic wishes. It is also beneficial to check whether your neighborhood has specific design restrictions and to prepare a temporary living plan so daily routines remain manageable while major work occurs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Compile functional priorities, set a clear budget with contingency funds, locate home plans, and determine temporary living arrangements before work begins.
